title: Instance uniforms are mismapped in forward+ renderer
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in 4.6 ### System information Godot v4.6.stable - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (Intel Corporation; 32.0.101.7082) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-1135G7 @ 2.40GHz (8 threads) - 15.72 GiB memory ### Issue description We create (or import) an Array mesh with two surfaces, in this case a cube with three sides each. We assign unique ShaderMaterials and shaders to these. We insert the line `ALBEDO = (1,0,0);` resp `ALBEDO = (0,1,0);` in each shader. We get the following expected result: (This shows there is no duplication of shaders or anything). If we then insert the following lines int the two shaders: `instance uniform vec3 color_0:source_color` and `instance uniform vec3 color_1:source_color` we can see them showing up in the instance overrides as expected. We also change color_0 to white. We get the following: Now, when we instead of setting the ALBEDO to green resp. red, we set them to the instance uniforms, we would expect the three sides of the cube that maps to the shader for color_0 to be black, and the other three to be white since the uniforms, shaders and materials are all separate. However the entire cube is black like the following: Then we change color_1 to blue, we get an entire blue cube: In summary these two shaders seem to have a slight ownership problem over their uniforms and need some help... ### Steps to reproduce 1. Open scene. 2. Change "color_0" and "color_1" 3. Observe weirdness. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [shader_error_scene.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25170307/shader_error_scene.zip)
